newsitem.title: UK: East Mids rejects Dominion at current levels.
newsitem.headline: East Mids rejects Dominion at current levels.

text.p: East Midlands Electricity said on Thursday it would reject any takeover offer made by U.S. energy group Dominion Resources at a price near 608p per share -- which Dominion has said it is considering.
"East Midlands would reject an offer at that level, which it believes would undervalue East Midlands Electricity's prospects under its existing management team," the company said in a statement.
East Mids rejects Dominion at current =2
Dominion disclosed its interest in East Midlands on Wednesday after the target company's share had leapt some 70p in heavy, rumour-driven trade, closing at 607.5 pence.
It said it had been evaluating a potential offer for East Midlands "at a price not much in excess of 608p per share".
Thursday's statement quoted East Midlands' chairman Nigel Rudd as saying: "We wait to see if Dominion Resources is prepared to make an offer and, if so, at what level.
"At this level, our clear advice to shareholders would be to reject such an offer," he added.
